dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, linear 2D narrowing of the lateral margins beginning posterior to the mid-section and terminating at the visible peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light slate-grey skin tone with high-intensity specular highlights concentrated near the blowhole and anterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency shading of darker grey clusters along the central longitudinal axis and the anterior cephalic region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients with low contrast between the primary slate-grey canvas and darker pigmented midline areas.
